Regime rocket attack | Young man killed in Al-Atarib city, west Aleppo countryside

Aleppo province: SOHR activists have documented the death of a young man in a regime rocket attack that hit Al-Atarib city in the western countryside of Aleppo.

SOHR activists also monitored an intensive rocket attack by regime, as regime forces fired 30 rockets on Kafrtaal town in the western countryside of Aleppo.

Early morning, SOHR activists monitored a rocket attack carried out by regime forces, targeting areas in Al-Futirah, Banin, and Fulifil in Jabal Al-Zawiyah in the southern countryside of Idlib, while Al-Fatah operations room factions have bombed regime positions on Kafr Batikh frontline in the south-eastern countryside of Idlib.
